function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location, positive for N and negative for S. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location, positive for E and negative for W. This is a float type value.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level for the location. The default value represents no elevation downscaling.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

message.content:
**Park Ji‑sung** (박지성) – commonly known as **Ji‑sung Park** in Western contexts – is a retired South Korean professional footballer who played primarily as a midfielder. Below is a concise overview of his life and career:

| Category | Details |
|----------|---------|
| **Full name** | Park Ji‑sung (박지성) |
| **Date of birth** | 27 February 1981 |
| **Place of birth** | Seoul, South Korea |
| **Height** | 1.78 m (5 ft 10 in) |
| **Position(s)** | Defensive midfielder, central midfielder, full‑back (occasionally) |
| **Youth club** | Suwon Samsung Bluewings (1998–2000) |

### Club Career Highlights

| Years | Club | Appearances (League) | Goals |
|-------|------|----------------------|-------|
| 2000–2001 | Suwon Samsung Bluewings | 12 | 0 |
| 2001–2005 | PSV Eindhoven (Netherlands) | 112 | 11 |
| 2005–2011 | Manchester United (England) | 151 | 6 |
| 2011–2014 | Tottenham Hotspur (England) | 71 | 1 |
| 2014–2015 | FC Seoul (South Korea) | 20 | 0 |
| 2015–2017 | FC Seoul (South Korea) | 30 | 0 |

- **Premier League**: 151 appearances, 6 goals (Manchester United)
- **FA Cup**: 5 wins (Manchester United)
- **UEFA Champions League**: 1 win (Manchester United, 2008–09)
- **Eredivisie**: 112 appearances, 11 goals (PSV Eindhoven)

### International Career

- **South Korea U‑23**: 2000–2002 | 13 caps, 1 goal
- **South Korea Senior Team**: 2000–2015 | 100 caps, 3 goals
- **Major tournaments**: 2002 FIFA World Cup (semi‑finalist), 2004 AFC Asian Cup (champion), 2010 FIFA World Cup, 2014 FIFA World Cup

### Playing Style & Reputation

- Known for exceptional stamina, work rate, and tactical versatility.
- Nicknamed “The Iron Man” for his relentless energy on the pitch.
- Praised for his passing accuracy, defensive contributions, and leadership qualities.

### Post‑Retirement

- Retired from professional football in 2017.
- Engaged in various philanthropic activities, including support for youth sports programs in South Korea.
- Occasionally appears as a football analyst and commentator.

### Personal Life

- Married to Kim Hye‑jin (former Miss Korea) in 2014.
- Father to a son, born in 2015.

---

**Key Takeaway:** Park Ji‑sung is celebrated as one of South Korea’s most iconic footballers, renowned for his durability, versatility, and contributions both at club level (especially with Manchester United) and internationally.
